senses.gloss: m., פִּקַּחַת, פִּיקַּ׳ f. (b. h.; preced. wds.) [open,]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 14:1">Yeb. XIV, 1</cite> <he>חרש שנשא פ׳ ופ׳ וכ׳</he> if a deaf mute married one hearing, or a hearing person married &c.; <he>פ׳ שנשא פ׳ ונתחרשה</he> if one hearing married one hearing, and she became deaf (and dumb); a. fr.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 36:2">Ex. R. s. 36</cite> <he>משל לפ׳ וסומא וכ׳</he> like a seeing and a blind man walking together &c.
Ex. R. s. 3 (ref. to Ex. IV, 11) פ׳ לראייה פ׳ לשמיעה piḳḳeaḥ refers both to sight and to hearing; a. e.
<cite ref="Ketubot 88a:1">Keth. 88ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>אי פ׳ הוא וכ׳</he> if he (the husband) be prudent, he may cause her to have an oath administered to her according to Biblical law.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:7:3">Y. Meg. II, end, 73ᶜ</cite> <he>הוי פ׳ ושתוק</he> be prudent and keep silence; <cite ref="Yoma 7a:2">Yoma 7ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:7:5">Y. Sabb. II, end, 5ᶜ</cite> <he>אשה פ׳</he> a wise woman; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פִּקְחִים</he>, <cite ref="Q01506"><he>פִּקְחִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00061"><he>פִּי׳</he></cite>; <he>פִּקְחוֹת</he>, <cite ref="Q00061"><he>פִּי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 153a:6">Sabb. 153ᵃ</cite>. Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᶜ; <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 15:10">Treat. Sof’rim XV, 10</cite> <he>רובן … פ׳</he> most bastards are bright; a. fr.
